stateRules: Verified complete private JPEG is required, including exact imported JPEG or explicitly confirmed PNG white-background working JPEG. Preview-only camera photos remain pure browsing; photo/account epochs reject old work.
Preserve default filters/online, actual categories, independent verified online catalog/cache, source reset and stable card/scroll identities from 80.
No-filter, zero preset strength and selecting a different preset preserve manual values and geometry; neutral manual/geometry preserve prior model identities.
Verified original → preset/strength → manual colour → resolution-scaled clarity/sharpening → normalized rotation/straighten/crop; never accumulate over prior preview or JPEG.
PED3 immutable account/photo drafts include preset bytes, strength, all manual values, geometry and model. PED1/PED2 missing geometry migrates neutral; PED1 missing manual values migrate zero.
Honor explicit saved versions and parked pending drafts. Fully matching latest exported drafts can restore saved editing settings; missing historical geometry is not reconstructed from pixels.
Neutral manual resets and unchanged exact input are true no-ops; reset adjustments retains preset/geometry, reset all clears preset/manual/geometry while preserving saved versions.
Flush drafts at leave/pause. Full identities and completion checks include non-neutral geometry; late exports cannot mark newer edits exported.
Keep 32 current-session undo steps; composition Apply and single-photo recipe apply are one step. Cancel/Back in crop never mutates the draft.
Recipes reuse colour snapshots only, preserving every target geometry. Batch recipe apply updates drafts before separate explicit export.
Freeze at most 100 full per-photo export snapshots; retry only failed/unprocessed entries. Full-pixel JPEG 95/sRGB; no silent downscale.

83 destination contract: camera/sync-effects/live initially APP_ONLY, edited export initially PHONE_ALBUM; remember accepted scene/project choice. Freeze target/extra-copy through task/retry. App-only creates no MediaStore row. First new phone publication is dated now. With an effective exact verified same-version public copy, reuse by default; explicit extra-copy is required to add another. New publication changes staged JPEG date metadata without pixel recompression; preserve old public copies/render-cache bytes/original bytes and time, and update local effect mtime after successful publication.
Private exact published-byte receipts support pending recovery. Exclusive local deletion validates all receipts/content/ownership before removal; modified or foreign public copies block deletion.
No NCP/NP3, camera-slot, live-default or NEF mutation; no new curves/HSL, beauty, generation, RAW development or auto-enhance entry.
Photo-live with initialized storage and no selected project skips project-config lookup instead of passing an empty ID to UUID parsing; storage validation remains strict.
Queued recipe clicks use latest-request identity; held-IO A→B regression confirms B wins, target geometry persists and only one undo step is committed.

Inline/picker categories share selectCategory: synchronize both selection strips, actual filtered grid/count and scroll reset; title shows source/category/actual count. Category choice preserves applied edits.
Live preview completion updates only attached matching Entry cards; card-local READY image survives LRU pressure/rebind for same entry/key; normal note line reserves row height.
ERROR/UNSUPPORTED override cached/retained imagery: clear old image and disable content; ERROR retry remains visible. Account/page/generation guards remain.

Actual category/GRID/swipe MotionEvents verify results. None only uses explicit bound performClick and single callback; pointer injection was inconclusive. Old81 offline category taps passed; no physical user-fault reproduction is claimed.

Phone browsing is authorized read-only paging/thumbnail loading; explicit chosen import creates durable private data, never a full-library copy or automatic upload. PNG source retained after explicit white-background JPEG confirmation.

Unchanged imported JPEG may reuse its exact readable MediaStore original as read-only provenance, never owned deletion authority. Missing/changed differs from unavailable verification; uncertainty requires recovery or explicit new copy. PNG working JPEG needs separate publication.

Accept configured /data/user/0 versus /data/data private-root aliases while retaining traversal, child-symlink, containment and ownership checks. Stale app-owned publication receipts are handled under exact-byte/ownership guards.
photoFilterEditor.assets: 83 adds 0 production rasters/icons. Runtime gallery photos are authorized phone media or durable private originals/versions. Generated JPEG/transparent PNG and structural NEF are QA fixtures only. No new comp or visual world.

narrative.overview:
0.4.0-beta 已实现用户批准的 Apple 风格方案：云白背景、白色分组、石墨文字、蓝色操作和悬浮毛玻璃导航。视觉参考为 [已确认的设置页](docs/design-review/apple-glass/preview-settings-light.jpg)；用户在三目的地设置架构确认后说“开始实现”。这里记录实际原生 Android Java / Views 的实现，代码来源是 `UiPalette`、`MainActivity`、`AlbumPanel`、`GlassBar` 和 `AppIcon`。

界面以安静的内容层次和原生文字为基础。照片承担内容展示，连接操作集中在设置，预设库与相册只显示简短连接状态。深色使用独立石墨配色；按钮、系统返回、对话框和文件选择仍遵循 Android 行为。

0.5.0-beta（versionCode 17）沿用这一世界，扩展持久化外观选择、独立无线预设检测、模板模拟主图和轻量页面过渡。已下载主图（含在线卡片）明确标注手机近似，未下载在线项保留发布者样片，配套实拍独立展示。扩展继续由原生代码和既有语义角色主导。

0.5.1-beta（versionCode 18）仅扩展详情主图的原图对比：右下角安静的深色胶囊在按住时显示模板原图，松开恢复模拟效果；裁切与图像位置固定，角标明确当前状态。它延续既有摄影内容层次，不改变视觉世界与导航。

0.5.2-beta（versionCode 19）沿用同一世界，在已下载详情的照片下方加入紧凑的只读色调曲线卡；蓝色实际曲线与次要色虚线参考共享明确的输入、输出与图例。照片上的对比按钮缩短为“原图”，保持原有命中区域和交互说明。

83 / `0.16.0-beta` 在相同世界内将根目的地扩为“预设／同步／相册／设置”：同步保留相机流程，相册承载授权手机照片与正式 App 内照片；清晰选图、权限恢复和明确保存位置服务照片主体，不改变既有编辑器材料。
keyCharacteristics: 云白背景、石墨文字和白色分组。
蓝色操作、小胶囊来源切换与悬浮导航。
原生字号、安全区、返回和触摸反馈。
持久外观选择、轻量页面过渡与有标签的模板近似。
dos: Do 从 `UiPalette` 和原生组件提取当前规则，保持浅色与深色的完整角色对应。
Do 为连接、加载、错误、结果待核对提供文字，状态点只是辅助。
Do 让普通用户先理解预设、连接和目标槽位；协议调查留在辅助诊断中。
Do 保留系统返回、字号缩放、安全区、48dp 命中区域及真实缺图状态。
donts: Don't 将旧红白 tokens、浏览器原型或旧截图作为 0.4.0 的实现来源。
Don't 将概念照片、合成测试照片或用户私有配方作为可分发预设或实拍证据；内置 AI 模板仅用于明确标注的近似模拟，并保留来源。
Don't 将下载、登记读回一致、原生载入等效和实际拍摄效果混称为同一种成功。
Don't 将模拟器 UI 的 SHIP 结论扩大为真实相机、TalkBack、平板、物理手势或性能认证。
